name: appsec
description: 2 security scanning skills: appsec-scan (catalog-driven CI mirror — admin-managed scanner preference profiles, 4 components from the private GitLab CI/CD Catalog (Fortify SCA SAST, Dependency Scanning SBOM, Secret Detection, Container Scanning) with per-component version pinning (~latest or exact tag); approval-gated fix loop and a guided Vulnerability Report triage plan) and appsec-dast-sim (LLM-based DAST following OWASP WSTG v4.2 — no running app required).
